Instant scorecard & full review on submit
  1. Total duration of the examination is 180 minutes (3 hours). The countdown timer in the top bar will display the remaining time and automatically submit when it reaches zero.
  2. All 75 questions are compulsory: each subject has Section A (20 MCQs) and Section B (5 Numerical Value Questions).
  3. For MCQs, options are mapped cleanly to the official NTA Final Answer Key (Option 1–4). For Numerical questions, enter the exact integer/numeric answer using the on-screen virtual keypad or your keyboard.
  4. The Question Palette on the right shows the status of every question using the standard NTA symbols:
1You have not visited the question yet.
2You have not answered the question.
3You have answered the question.
4Marked for Review (not answered).
5Answered & Marked for Review (WILL be considered for evaluation).
